_doc: Ground-truth for the UI/UX taxonomy fixture (fixture-ux/index.html, fixture-ux/snapshot.json). Mirrors seeds.json's schema. Every seed's `id` matches a snapshot record's `seed` (and the fixture's `data-seed`) 1:1. axis:'ux-objective' is used uniformly for every gated definite-oracle UX family (content, i18n, image, invisible, modal, interaction) so they land in score.js's `ux` roll-up (perAxis['ux-objective']) AND the `overall` verdict-recall denominator (score.js's `overall` sums ALL non-advisory, non-perceptual positive seeds regardless of axis). polarity:'negative' marks negative-control seeds that MUST NOT be flagged (flagging one is a false positive against precision). stream:'advisory' marks the generic overlap-rect heuristic seed, excluded from the gated recall denominator (ADR-0008: heuristic-only unless corroborated). heldOut:true marks D1 (needs Task 2's localeDateSignal) and SS1 (checkStackIntegrity, sub-plan B) — the heldOutRecallMin gate check itself is wired in Task 4.

gate._note: Absolute recall on the gated ux-objective axis (== overall here, single-axis fixture) and overall precision. Negative-control seeds (polarity:negative) must NOT be flagged. Advisory stream (O2) reported, not gated. heldOutRecallMin enforced by Task 4.

seeds.title: Bare 'NaN' rendered whole-cell — a computed value leaked its raw JS artifact
'[object Object]' rendered — a value was stringified instead of formatted
Unrendered '{{amount}}' interpolation token leaked into the DOM
Raw ISO-8601 timestamp rendered instead of a formatted date
Untranslated dotted key 'deliverables.title' rendered as the label
'Save Changes' rendered in Latin script on an Arabic-locale page
mm/dd/yyyy-shaped date rendered on a non-month-first (Arabic) locale
Image failed to load (naturalWidth 0 after complete)
Foreground ~= background — text is effectively invisible
Modal z-index sits below its own backdrop's z-index — invisible behind it
Two controls' bounding boxes overlap by >25% — heuristic-only, advisory unless corroborated
Opening the 'New Deliverable' sheet destroyed the still-open 'Deliverables' overlay instead of stacking
Clean formatted currency value '1,250.00' — MUST NOT be flagged as a content artifact
'GitHub' brand name on an Arabic-locale page — MUST NOT be flagged as untranslated
Successfully-loaded image (naturalWidth 320) — MUST NOT be flagged broken
High-contrast text (#111 on #fff) — MUST NOT be flagged invisible
Child sheet correctly stacks over its declared parent overlay — MUST NOT be flagged destroyed
